title: What Happens When Your Stomach Growls?
description:
Stomach rumbling is the sound of gas and fluids moving through your digestive system, caused by the muscles of your stomach and intestines contracting. It can happen at any time, not just when you're hungry: swallowing air or drinking fizzy drinks can do it too. Most of these sounds are normal and simply mean your gut is working.
